title: Read a video's full structured script (segments + narrator + media)
description:
Synchronous, free. Returns every scene's narration, the per-scene UID
modify_scene needs, the currently-shown media URL, narrator clone
config, and global settings (aspect ratio, music, brand, language).
Mirrors the engine the dashboard's scene editor uses on open.

use_cases.title: 📜 Read a video's full script
use_cases.description: Paste a `widecast<...>` topic_id (the id returned by /v1/create_video) to read every scene's narration + voice_file + media URL + narrator config. Same data the scene editor sees on open.
